h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhavnagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhavnagar

c: Bhavnagar is a port city on the Gulf of Khambhat in Saurashtra, with the Alang ship-breaking yards and a large diamond-cutting trade in the same district. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhavnagar to municipal gardens, housing societies, schools, colleges and industrial campuses. The Fun Fitness range is made in our own factory at Vasai, in the neighbouring state of Maharashtra, and delivered by road.

Two kinds of weather act on outdoor equipment here. Salt air from the gulf corrodes untreated steel, and the hot, dry wind of a Saurashtra summer carries fine dust into anything with moving parts. We use galvanised pipe for the frames and roto-moulded plastic for seats and handles, and the bearings are housed so dust stays out. Coastal sites should be rinsed with fresh water every few weeks, and all sites benefit from a quick wipe of the handles before the busy morning hours.

items.q: Will salt air from the gulf damage outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Galvanised frames and plastic parts resist salt much better than painted steel. Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks on sites close to the sea, and report any damage to our after-sales team.

items.q: Can our company in Bhavnagar order a staff gym?
items.a: Yes. Send us the space available and the number of staff on each shift. We will suggest a mix of machines and send a layout with the clear zone for each one.

items.q: How do you deliver to Saurashtra?
items.a: We manufacture at Vasai and send the machines by road. Our team or a dealer covering western India installs them, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.
